sloka: तया महत्या यायिन्या ध्वजिन्या वनवासिन: ।अर्द्दिता यूथपा मत्ता: सयूथा: सम्प्रदुद्रुवु: ॥ २.९३.१॥
transliteration: tayā mahatyā yāyinyā dhvajinyā vanavāsina: ।ardditā yūthapā mattā: sayūthā: sampradudruvu: ॥ 2.93.1॥

translations.english: On seeing the great army marching, the exited leaders of herds of elephants inhabiting the forest were frightened and ran off with their herds.
